name: @blue-bee/ui
description: Blue Bee shared React Native component library (the 'Daylight' system) — the primitives all three Expo apps (customer/driver/owner) share: the theme layer (useTheme over @blue-bee/design-tokens colors), haptics, and components (Button, Text, + more in Task 3). Consumed as RAW TypeScript SOURCE by Metro (no dist build): `main`/`types` point at src so the editor, typecheck, jest, and the Metro bundler all resolve the SAME files — deliberately avoiding the stale-compiled-dist trap that a `dist/`-based `main` creates for packages/shared & packages/api-client.
